# Folders of this repository's own, where files may be added freely: CI,
# tests, packaging and documentation, none of it built into the product.
# tools/ci/pristine_guard.py allows an added path that matches one of these
# patterns. Every other difference from LiveCode's source (a file of
# LiveCode's changed or deleted, or a file added anywhere else) must be
# named, with its reason, in CHANGES-FROM-LIVECODE.md.
#
# One pattern per line, relative to the repository root; "*" matches within
# one path segment, "**" across segments; text after "#" is a comment.

.github/**
tools/ci/**
tools/oxt/**
tests/**
CHANGES-FROM-LIVECODE.md
Installer/legacyoxt/**
